examples.text: Released from these household chores, many wives have found jobs outside the home.
examples.translation: 从这些家务中解脱出来后，许多妻子找到了家庭之外的工作。
examples.speechText: Released from these household chores, many wives have found jobs outside the home.

examples.text: The presence of others does not always have to be physical.
examples.translation: 他人的陪伴不一定总需要面对面（身体的在场）。
examples.speechText: The presence of others does not always have to be physical.

examples.text: Many people hope that the whole world will one day speak a common language.
examples.translation: 许多人希望，有一天全世界都会说同一种通用语言。
examples.speechText: Many people hope that the whole world will one day speak a common language.

examples.text: So it's really about changing the culture and slowing（slow的-ing形式） traffic down.

examples.speechText: So it's really about changing the culture and slowing traffic down.

examples.text: The main purpose of this passage is mostly to outline the history of the development of quake-resistant building materials.
examples.translation: 这篇文章的主要目的是概述抗震建筑材料的发展历史。
examples.speechText: The main purpose of this passage is mostly to outline the history of the development of quake-resistant building materials.

examples.text: It was so hard to sell a story that I barely made enough to eat.
examples.translation: 故事很难卖出去，我赚到的钱几乎只够糊口。
examples.speechText: It was so hard to sell a story that I barely made enough to eat.

examples.text: Every time you are online, you may find pictures, articles（article的复数形式）, links and videos trying to tell their stories.
examples.translation: 每次上网，你都可能看到试图讲述各自故事的图片、文章、链接和视频。
examples.speechText: Every time you are online, you may find pictures, articles, links and videos trying to tell their stories.

examples.text: Concentrate on his or her feelings rather than your own.
examples.translation: 把注意力放在对方的感受上，而不是你自己的感受上。
examples.speechText: Concentrate on his or her feelings rather than your own.

examples.text: They already had two dogs at home and were hoping to find the ideal companion (伙伴) for their family.
examples.translation: 她们家里已经有两只狗，希望能为他们的家庭找到一只理想的伙伴。
examples.speechText: They already had two dogs at home and were hoping to find the ideal companion for their family.

examples.text: Their genes passed to future generations.
examples.translation: 它们的基因传给了后代。
examples.speechText: Their genes passed to future generations.

examples.text: Mary identified her bag at the first sight by seeing its color.
examples.translation: Mary一眼就根据颜色认出了自己的包。
examples.speechText: Mary identified her bag at the first sight by seeing its color.

examples.text: Cash was the best way to teach people about financial knowledge because it's so easy to grasp.
examples.translation: 用现金是传授金融知识的最佳方式，因为它十分直观易懂。
examples.speechText: Cash was the best way to teach people about financial knowledge because it's so easy to grasp.

examples.text: The poverty line is the lowest income that people need for an acceptable standard of living.
examples.translation: 贫困线是指维持可接受生活水平所需的最低收入。
examples.speechText: The poverty line is the lowest income that people need for an acceptable standard of living.

examples.text: What matters to him is whether the job allows him to pursue his studies.
examples.translation: 对他来说，重要的是这份工作是否允许他继续学业。
examples.speechText: What matters to him is whether the job allows him to pursue his studies.
